name: name
description: Full name of the person who wrote to us

name: greetingName
description: Their first name if we can tell it apart, otherwise their full name

name: contactCode
description: Reference code for the message, e.g. MSG-0001-03-26

name: phone
description: Phone number, when they gave one

name: message
description: What they wrote, so they can see we have it in full

name: messageExcerpt
description: The first couple of lines of their message, for a short template

name: contactDate
description: When they wrote, formatted for reading

name: replyWithinHours
description: The reply commitment the website makes, in hours

name: source
description: Which form or channel it arrived through
